primary_geography_policy: User approved CT area weighting for the complete pilot and a consistent CT-based method for all 24 future corridors; DA retained as a comparison after source suppression was found.
allocation_formula: a_it = area(catchment_i intersect tract_t) / area(tract_t); N_i = sum(a_it * L_t); P_i = sum(a_it * P_t); share_i = N_i / P_i
denominator_scope: All Census residents; includes people outside the LIM private-household universe. This custom share is not official LIM-AT prevalence.
uniformity_assumption: Total population and low-income population are separately uniform within each whole CT cartographic polygon. This is a spatial estimator, not an observed corridor count.
source_missingness_policy: Preserve every suppressed or unavailable source count. A positive-weight missing count blocks a complete ratio. Do not infer a suppressed DA value from CT data.
catchment: 500 m continuous road-centreline buffer; corridor 01 geometry and endpoint proxies remain provisional
direction_rationale: User-chosen priority for higher concentrations of low-income residents; measures local concentration, not realized benefits or a Palma ratio.
midpoint_population_scenario: (25300 + 40059) / 2 = 32679.5; midpoint of DB count bounds, not an area-weighted estimator
stress_test_contract: Hold the CT area-allocated low-income numerator fixed and substitute DB lower, midpoint and upper population denominators. These are denominator-only stress scenarios, not jointly estimated demographic configurations or confidence limits.
ranking_status: not_run; selected City inputs still contain missing values and admissions are unresolved
